question: Where is the nearest restaurant when heading toward Forty Oaks, Clarkston, GA from Centennial High School Football Stadium, Roswell, GA?
sql: WITH start_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Centennial High School Football Stadium%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Roswell%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%GA%' LIMIT 1 ), end_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Forty Oaks%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Clarkston%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%GA%' LIMIT 1 ), target_azimuth_calc AS ( SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(s.geometry, e.geometry)) AS bearing, s.geometry AS start_geom_val FROM start_point s, end_point e ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois AS p, target_azimuth_calc AS tac WHERE p.amenity = 'restaurant' AND ST_DWithin(tac.start_geom_val::geography, p.geometry::geography, 50000) -- Limit search radius to 50km for performance AND ( -- Calculate the shortest angular distance between the target bearing (start to end) -- and the bearing from the start point to the current restaurant. -- Check if this angular distance is within +/- 45 degrees (a 90-degree cone). LEAST( ABS(degrees(ST_Azimuth(tac.start_geom_val, p.geometry)) - tac.bearing), 360 - ABS(degrees(ST_Azimuth(tac.start_geom_val, p.geometry)) - tac.bearing) ) <= 45 ) ORDER BY ST_Distance(tac.start_geom_val::geography, p.geometry::geography) ASC LIMIT 1;
